mapper.select: SELECT TUM.USER_ID, TUM.EMAIL, TUM.NAME, TUM.PHONE, TUM.STATUS, TURM.ROLE FROM TB_USER_MANAGE TUM INNER JOIN TB_USER_ROLE_MANAGE TURM ON TUM.USER_ID = TURM.USER_ID WHERE TUM.EMAIL = #{EMAIL}
